summary: Warns that the Ansible Python API is internal and unsupported for external use, recommending ansible-runner for running playbooks or modules and AWX for non-Python, async, or access-controlled use.
questions: Is it supported to call Ansible from my own Python code?
What should I use instead of the Ansible Python API to run playbooks from a script?
How can I trigger Ansible runs from another language with logging and access control?

answer_card.title: Using Ansible from Python
answer_card.answer_md: The Ansible Python API is for **internal use** and can change at any time, so external use is unsupported. To run playbooks or modules programmatically, use **ansible-runner**. For other languages, async triggers, access control or logging, look at **AWX**.
